name: Hotel Pension Almrausch Danler
beschreibung: The Hotel Pension Almrausch Danler is located on the quiet edge of Neustift im Stubaital. Its proximity to the valley stations of the Elferbahnen and to the Stubaier Gletscher makes it a practical base for active holidaymakers. The house combines traditional Tiroler style with a family atmosphere. Amenities include rooms with a balcony and mountain views, a breakfast buffet, and a sauna area. In the evening, guests can choose regional dishes in the hotel's own restaurant. The quiet location on the valley floor is ideal for guests who want to combine relaxation with sporting activities in the Stubaier Alpen.
